title: When an app cancels logout until you handle its prompt, logging out again loses state for what was open at the original logout (which is what you wanted saved)
line: When an app stops a logout to ask something, logging out again now still restores every app that was open the first time.
explanation: At logout plasma-shutdown runs plasma-fallback-session-save, which wipes plasmasessionrestorestaterc and writes the apps that are open right then. If an app then cancels the logout with a prompt, the other apps have already been closed, so the next logout attempt overwrote the save with only the app that had prompted. Now a logout save in a session whose earlier logout already saved adds to that list instead of replacing it, and the restore at login clears the marker so the first logout of each new session still starts from scratch.

commits.message:
session-restore: Keep windows saved by a cancelled logout

When an app cancelled the logout, the windows already closed by it were
lost, as the next logout saved the session again from scratch. Logouts
now add to what an earlier one of the same session saved instead.

BUG: 501472

media.caption: Master: Dolphin, System Monitor and Konsole (running sleep) open, logout cancelled at Konsole's prompt, logout again: the saved session now holds only Konsole.
With the fix, same steps: the second logout keeps Dolphin and System Monitor from the first attempt.
